model.growth: d phi/dt = beta lap phi + k_alpha alpha - P(max(0, phi - 1) + min(0, phi)); d alpha/dt = k_alpha phi; RK4, zero flux on every face of the box, phi(0) = CLSM phi, alpha(0) = 1
model.beta: 0.02 mm^2/T* (H / 0.25 mm)^2, H = biovolume per substratum area of the stack (phi > 0.3)
model.mechanics: hex8 B-bar, E = 10.0 Pa (phi^2 + 0.001), nu = 0.49, eigenstrain (alpha - 1) I, substratum clamped, top free, lateral faces on rollers; pyamg smoothed aggregation + CG
model.phi: clip((S - S_p10) / (S_p95 - S_p10), 0, 1) of the smoothed channel sum S (sigma 1.44 um lateral, 1.0 um in z); film = phi > 0.3
model.substratum: plane fitted to the first film slice of every column (the sharp edge at the low z index), columns shifted to z = 0 (integer slices), box cut at H_top + 30 % (at least 3 slices)
model.voxel: 0.18 um pixels, 1024 px per field, lateral stride of the arrays; z step = pooled stack depth of the day (zprofiles_all_ti.csv) / slices of the stack
model.bands: bottom: z < H_top/4 (at least the first slice), middle: to 3 H_top/4, top: above; H_top = top of the last slice where the film covers at least 5 % of the area
model.units: stress Pa, lengths mm in the solver, um in the tables
